_comment: Gallery preview artifacts generated from web gallery winners.

gallery_winner_showcase.name: Gallery Winner Showcase
gallery_winner_showcase.description: A VR showroom that previews the highest-rated image from each gallery as a wall of framed panels.
gallery_winner_showcase.qfep_connection: The scoreboard given a room: only each gallery's highest-rated image earns a frame, and where a config survives, the winner is re-grown live from its grammar. Curation by stars, with the losing runs simply absent from the wall.

dna.default: hang=grid - the `_:` branch of _panel_transform() reproduces the shipped arithmetic literally (same `index % columns`, same integer division, same centring term, same flat y), and all 10 live placements are bare `gallery_winner_showcase:180:0.0` tokens carrying no config at all, so GridInteractablesComponent never even calls apply_grid_config on them. The wall renders exactly as before.
dna.was: four columns of equal panels at equal spacing at equal height, always - the contact sheet, the specimen rack, the spreadsheet. That grid is not neutral: it claims these winners are comparable units of the same kind, and it was the only claim the artifact could make.
dna.note: DECLINED the exhibit_furniture `house` vocabulary (white_cube|wunderkammer|depot|forensic) that was offered. That axis names which institution a BODY belongs to and spends itself on material - oak and brass, ply and orange strap, brushed steel. This artifact's shipped register is a dark slate rack carrying unshaded emissive image planes, a lit screen in a dark room, which is none of the six. Borrowing the word would force either a seventh value into a family vocabulary already widened once by agreement, or a default of white_cube that repaints all existing placements. The default rule wins, so the word is refused and `hang` - how a selection is arranged, which is the curatorial argument a showroom of winners actually makes - is taken instead. Layout only: panel geometry, materials, labels, stars and the live-object pedestal are untouched by every value.

composition_platform.name: Composition Platform
composition_platform.description: Pedestal that captures the player-stacked composition into a primitive_stack JSON config — closes the loop from upgraded conveyor (vocabulary feeder) to the gallery pipeline.
